events.prompt: A 24-year-old adult Korean woman with her natural fair skin tone and round cheeks that dimple when she smiles, bright honey-orange brown hair in a layered Korean wolf cut. Curvy figure, 161 cm tall, bust 91 cm, waist 58 cm, hips 90 cm, F cup, full chest and slim waist. Light makeup with a glossy lip, her cheeks flushed pink from the cold. She wears a long deep-cranberry wool coat over an ivory ribbed knit mini dress, white knee-high boots and small pearl earrings. A quiet, environmental full-length portrait of a snowy hot-spring town street at blue hour, with snow falling softly. Low wooden inns with closed sliding doors line the street, and small warm paper lanterns glow along the eaves, receding into the distance. She stands in the middle of the street seen from a comfortable distance, with the street clearly surrounding her, in the soft glow of the lanterns, and tilts her face up to watch the falling snow with a small smile, not looking at the camera. Framing from top to bottom: a narrow band of rooftops and deep-blue sky, then the lantern-lit street with her whole figure, then open snowy road in front of her; both boots are fully in frame with snow below them. The warm lantern glow touches her face, her coat and the snow around her, and the rest of the scene stays cool blue. Vertical 3:4, eye level, natural perspective. A clean street with no shop signs, posters, wires, pipes or clutter. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading, finished like a page from a high-end photobook.
